concept: One short case story told on real screens: Maya's desk on the left, another desk somewhere else on the right, the same sign-in page on both. The split frame returns at each turn of the story, so the viewer compares outcomes on the thief's screen, not diagrams.

story.setting: Maya's office and another desk somewhere else
story.arc: the copied password works (b01-b03), the code stops it (b04-b07), the look-alike page relays it (b08-b11), the passkey gives nothing (b12-b14), the numbers (b15-b16), the prompt she refuses (b17-b18), payoff (b19-b21)

cast.name: Maya
cast.role: the employee whose account it is (invented)

cast.name: someone else
cast.role: an ordinary person seen from behind at a plain desk (invented); never a hooded hacker

motifs.name: the sign-in page
motifs.desc: the same page on both desks at every turn; its state is the outcome

motifs.name: Maya's phone
motifs.desc: on her desk: the code, the prompts, the passkey

motifs.name: the address bar
motifs.desc: login.yourwork.example and the look-alike with -help; large in b08 and b14

design.treatment: Wide office (Loom.place.office), Maya behind her desk in the type pose, the laptop lid toward us. Her screen is shown beside her as a large inset (what she sees), joined to her laptop by a thin line: the sign-in page at login.yourwork.example. The password dots type in, the page cuts to Welcome, Maya. One slow push toward Maya and the inset.
design.why_motion: the story moves: a screen changes state, something travels, someone waits
elements: maya (rig maya, type pose, behind the desk)

beat_sheet.action: Maya is in place; tag Maya

design.continuity: The inset becomes the left half of the split in b02 (same page, same address).

scenes.subject: the same password typed far away

design.treatment: The split (Loom.mfa.split): Maya's laptop left with her page at Welcome; the other desk right, a person from behind at a monitor. On 'leaked' a small tag 'leaked from another site' pins to Maya's password; on 'types it' the dots type on the right page; on 'opens for them too' it cuts to Welcome, Maya there as well.
design.why_motion: the story moves: a screen changes state, something travels, someone waits
design.continuity: Held through b05: split, laptop, monitor, both pages, thief, Maya's phone.

design.treatment: Both screens read Welcome, Maya. A round equals badge settles on the divider with the words something you know under it; the two people are different, the screens identical.
design.why_motion: the comparison is the content; one reveal on the divider
elements: badge on the divider: '=' and 'something you know'

beat_sheet.action: a soft highlight rings the right welcome

design.continuity: The badge leaves at the start of b04.

design.treatment: The right side dims. Maya's page goes back to the password, the dots type, then it cuts to Enter the code; her phone on the desk lights with 482 913; the digits type into the boxes; Welcome, Maya.
design.why_motion: the story moves: a screen changes state, something travels, someone waits

beat_sheet.action: the phone lights with the code, a buzz

design.continuity: The phone stays on Maya's desk through b05.

scenes.subject: the thief stopped at the code

design.treatment: The right side undims. The other person types the password again: it works, then Enter the code; empty boxes and a blinking caret. Across the divider Maya's phone lights with a code she did not ask for and stays on her desk. On 'They stop' a red outline closes round the empty boxes.
design.why_motion: the story moves: a screen changes state, something travels, someone waits

beat_sheet.t_anchor: The code is on Maya's phone

design.continuity: Everything leaves at the b06 join.

design.treatment: Close on Maya's desk: three large objects in a row, the password field with dots, her phone with the code, a fingerprint pad; MFA and its long name across the top. Each object lifts and takes its label as it is named.
design.why_motion: a definition: a static composition revealed in the order spoken

design.treatment: Left, the other desk's monitor small, still on Enter the code. Right, two plain bars: Without MFA full; With MFA shrinking from full to a sliver; 99.22% named last with Microsoft researchers, their own business accounts, under it; on 'not a guarantee' the sliver gets a small ring.
design.why_motion: a quantity changing: the bar shrinks

beat_sheet.action: shrinks to the sliver; the value names

design.treatment: The split again. Maya's laptop shows a message asking her to sign in with a link button; the click cuts to a sign-in page identical to hers. The address bar reads login.yourwork-help.example. On 'Only the address is different' the -help turns red and the address bar is copied large above the window. The other desk waits on the real sign-in page.
design.why_motion: the story moves: a screen changes state, something travels, someone waits

beat_sheet.t_anchor: Maya gets a link to sign in
beat_sheet.action: the message appears; the link is pressed

design.treatment: Maya types her password on the look-alike page, then her code (her phone lights). A question card drops in over the divider: Does the thief get in? with two chips, Yes and No. Silence holds.
design.why_motion: the story moves: a screen changes state, something travels, someone waits

design.treatment: The card lifts. What Maya typed travels across the divider: a chip of password dots, then a chip with 482 913, each landing in the right page's field; the right page cuts to Welcome, Maya.
design.why_motion: the story moves: a screen changes state, something travels, someone waits

scenes.subject: what you type can be asked for

design.treatment: Maya's phone and the typed code on her page side by side: the code on her phone takes a soft ring (hers alone); then the typed code on the page is underlined and a tag reads anything you type.
design.why_motion: the story moves: a screen changes state, something travels, someone waits
design.continuity: Everything leaves at the b12 join.

design.treatment: Maya's phone large at left; a key settles inside it behind the glass; the screen shows Use your passkey with a fingerprint; a soft pulse on the fingerprint as it unlocks.
design.why_motion: the story moves: a screen changes state, something travels, someone waits

beat_sheet.action: the key settles into the phone

scenes.subject: the signed answer
scenes.world: her phone and the real page

design.treatment: The real sign-in page at right (passkey state). A small question card travels from the page into the phone; an answer card travels back stamped login.yourwork.example; the page cuts to Welcome, Maya. The key never moves.
design.why_motion: the story moves: a screen changes state, something travels, someone waits

design.treatment: The split: Maya's laptop on the look-alike page with only a Sign in with a passkey button; her phone beside it. The address is shown large above the window, -help in red. The phone reads it and stays dark. The other desk waits on Check your phone with nothing arriving.
design.why_motion: the story moves: a screen changes state, something travels, someone waits

design.treatment: Three plain vertical bars on a light field, rising one per phrase: texted code 76 percent, phone prompt 90, security keys with the words no one fell. Google study, its own accounts, under them.
design.why_motion: a quantity per method

design.treatment: The bars hold. One line settles under them: any second factor beats none. The third bar keeps a thin dashed outline above it (not a wall).
design.why_motion: a limit: a static line

beat_sheet.action: a soft arrow up the three bars

scenes.subject: a prompt she did not start

design.treatment: The split: left, Maya's phone large on her desk; right, the other desk on Check your phone. The phone buzzes: Is this you signing in?; again; again, the prompts stacking.
design.why_motion: the story moves: a screen changes state, something travels, someone waits

design.treatment: Maya's thumb presses Deny; the prompts fall away; the phone goes dark. The right page cuts to Sign-in denied.
design.why_motion: the story moves: a screen changes state, something travels, someone waits

design.treatment: Three things in a row: the password field (a copy slides out of it), the code (it slides toward a small other monitor), the phone with its key (the real address stamp). Each outcome as it is named.
design.why_motion: a recap that replays each outcome
